@Pree, it's the Pine Crossing store. You posted on 9 June in #central-team that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it using the store login.

Pine Crossing is the only name I could find for that site. I didn't see an address, store number or door for it in this channel or in the shared files. If you need one of those for the sheet, the store ops contact you called would be the person to ask.
